title: Rioproperty arrow link
description: A small capitalised link in the wide display face with a thin up-right arrow. On hover an underline draws in from the left and the arrow nudges up and right; it can fade in with the scroll as it enters.
notes: tone highlight (yellow) is meant for violet or indigo backgrounds
without href it renders a <button> (type submit for forms)
name: rioproperty-arrow-link

props.name: children
props.description: the label, set in the wide display face in capitals

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the link is a <button>

props.name: type
props.description: for a <button>: the form button type

props.name: tone
props.description: primary: violet (on paper); highlight: yellow (on violet or indigo)

props.name: reveal
props.description: fade in with the scroll as it enters the window, as the original's links do
